parole.significato: A variety of curd cheese made from sheep’s or goat’s milk and originating from Greece.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Greek φέτα (féta), from Italian fetta (“slice”).

parole.significato: A handwoven woolen rug with a thick pile.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Greek φλοκάτη (flokáti), from φλόκι (flóki, “flock, shag”), from Italian flocco.

parole.significato: A Greek resinated white or rosé wine of a sort that has been produced for at least 2700 years.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Greek ρετσίνα (retsína), from Byzantine Greek ῥετσίνα (rhetsína), from Italian resina (“resin”). Doublet of resin.
